
REMOVE-EXAMPLE
Remove an example from Example Mapping by index

USAGE
  fspec remove-example <workUnitId> <index>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Example index (from show-work-unit)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Remove example at index 2
  $ fspec remove-example AUTH-001 2
  ✓ Removed example from AUTH-001

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-example
  fspec show-work-unit
